artifact_transfer.content_markdown: Revision 8 supports D5-O01 through D5-O10. D5-VP-C07 is closed: B-malformed defines exactly one shared four-fixture set—non-object, missing resolution_id, empty-string resolution_id, and non-string resolution_id—and each boundary, aggregate, rendering, persistence, and external case explicitly exercises that same set. Every case requires exactly one schema_invalid platform_resolution_rejected correlated by resolution_input_sha256, forbids platform_resolution_validated and all owner/gate/surface/publication events, and forbids canonical platform_resolution_state, in addition to its consumer-specific outcome. B-semantic-invalid remains a separate stable-resolution_id route that reaches semantic validation and terminates through validated-invalid state rather than structural rejection. No actionable gap was found.

evidence.claim: The frozen contract grounds the required three-layer hierarchy and downstream behavior.
The plan defines exact layer schemas, parent rules, surface-owned projection, persistence, rendering, and rejection behavior.
Frozen evidence behavior grounds proof and effective-usability enforcement.
The plan requires exactly-once per-surface human-centric proof bindings and blocks every dependent surface on missing, duplicate, wrong-scope, or unusable proof.
The frozen source establishes the selected construction, all three tests, three rejected alternatives, and their distinct rationales.
The plan specifies canonical full-row candidate identities, exact fixture assertions, rationale preservation, uppercase consumer emphasis, and tamper rejection.
Frozen runner evidence grounds the ingestion, gating, persistence, and downstream integration points.
The plan binds Gate A to employee-sentiment evidence, both named claim-scoped owners, durable decisions, exact status derivation, and the people-claim transition.
The frozen contract grounds the national-frame interpretation test and named clearance identity.
The plan reconciles canonical legal_regulatory with its display identity and requires durable exact-claim clearance before publication.
Frozen publication evidence grounds the complete semantic audit and external gate.
The plan defines the closed claim-class inventory and requires evidence plus approved exact-claim legal_regulatory clearance for every sensitive class.
Frozen store behavior supports backward-compatible durable state without historical rewrite.
The plan separates invalid, proposed, approved_to_test, and public_locked with canonical authorization and permits committed publication only from public_locked public surfaces.
Frozen final-strategy evidence grounds the existing flat consumer that the plan replaces.
The plan proves independent product test-only activation while the combined national/people surface remains blocked until both gates pass, with no test-only publication.
The frozen obligation requires both equivalent generic traversal and runtime-source proof against client phrase aliases.
The plan keeps client values in signed fixtures, requires a non-Vivacom equivalent fixture, and supplies an executable scan across every approved production file.
Frozen monitoring behavior grounds the real runner/store/monitor protocol that must remain identity-correlated.

The executable matrix defines one exact four-fixture B-malformed set and binds all five consumers to the same one-rejection, input-hash correlation, no-validated, no-downstream, and no-canonical-state invariants; the separate stable-ID B-semantic-invalid route remains validated-invalid rather than structurally rejected.
